newsitem.title: USA: Banc One agrees to buy First USA for $7.3 billion. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Banc One agrees to buy First USA for $7.3 billion. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]

text.p: Banc One Corp. said on Monday it agreed to buy First USA Inc. for $7.3 billion, forming the third-largest U.S. credit card operation with about 32 million cardholders and assets of $35 billion.

Banc One said it agreed to pay 1.1659 shares of Banc One common stock, or about $52.61, for each share of Dallas-based First USA. First USA stock closed Friday at $36.75 a share on the New York Stock Exchange.
In pre-open stock trading, First USA's shares soared to $48 (corrects from $52.61), up $11.25, while Banc One's shares slipped to $42.50, down $2.875.
As part of the deal, Banc One will also buy First USA Paymentech Inc., a credit card payments processing business 57-percent owned by First USA.

In a joint statement, the two companies said First USA, with 16 million cardholders and managed receivables of $22.4 billion, would be merged into Banc One. which has 16 million cardholders and $12.6 billion in managed receivables.
The deal is expected to be completed by May 31, 1997.
